latestVersion.changelog:
agent-soul-manager v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Introduces persistent, evolving AI agent "souls" composed of structured beliefs, values, voice, and boundaries.
- Connects to the Live Neon platform for soul management and Pattern-Based Distillation from real agent behavior.
- Provides CLI commands for registering, syncing content, discovering and reviewing beliefs, and managing agent identities.
- Supports layering of identity at org, team, and individual agent levels.
- Allows manual observation reporting and curation of discovered traits and responsibilities.
- Designed for easy onboarding with simple registration and token setup.
